**Sample Selection Models in R**

`ssmodels` provides a unified implementation of classical and extended sample selection models. It supports the classical Gaussian Heckman model, the Heckman selection-t model, a skew-normal sample selection model, the generalized Heckman model with covariate-dependent dispersion and correlation parameters, and a Birnbaum--Saunders sample selection model.

The package is intended for researchers and practitioners working with non-random sample selection, missing outcomes induced by selection mechanisms, and flexible extensions of the classical Heckman framework.

## Installation

Install the released version from CRAN:

```r
install.packages("ssmodels")
```

Install the development version from GitHub:

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("fsbmat-ufv/ssmodels")
```

## Quick start

A classical Heckman sample selection model can be fitted using the `MEPS2001` data included with the package:

```r
library(ssmodels)

data("MEPS2001")

selection_eq <- dambexp ~ age + female + educ + blhisp + totchr + ins + income
outcome_eq   <- lnambx  ~ age + female + educ + blhisp + totchr + ins

fit <- HeckmanCL(selection_eq, outcome_eq, data = MEPS2001)
summary(fit)
```

## Implemented models

| Model | Main function | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| Classical Heckman | `HeckmanCL()` | Heckman (1976, 1979) |
| Heckman selection-t | `HeckmantS()` | Marchenko & Genton (2012) |
| Skew-normal sample selection | `HeckmanSK()` | Ogundimu & Hutton (2016) |
| Generalized Heckman | `HeckmanGe()` | Bastos, Barreto-Souza & Genton (2021) |
| Birnbaum--Saunders sample selection | `HeckmanBS()` | Bastos & Barreto-Souza (2020) |

## Associated research

The package implements methodology developed in, among others:

- Bastos, F. S., Barreto-Souza, W., & Genton, M. G. (2021). *A Generalized Heckman Model with Varying Sample Selection Bias and Dispersion Parameters*. **Statistica Sinica**. https://doi.org/10.5705/ss.202021.0068
- Bastos, F. S., & Barreto-Souza, W. (2020). *Birnbaum--Saunders Sample Selection Model*. **Journal of Applied Statistics**. https://doi.org/10.1080/02664763.2020.1780570
- Marchenko, Y. V., & Genton, M. G. (2012). *A Heckman Selection-t Model*. **Journal of the American Statistical Association**. https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.2012.656011
- Ogundimu, E. O., & Hutton, J. L. (2016). *A Sample Selection Model with Skew-Normal Distribution*. **Scandinavian Journal of Statistics**. https://doi.org/10.1111/sjos.12171
